scene: A flat straight-on view of what a person sees in a modern search engine: at the top a long empty grey rounded search bar; directly below it one large rounded grey answer card with three short plain grey bars of answer text; at the bottom of the card, one small brand blue browser-window thumbnail marked with a gold star, the source the answer was taken from. Nothing else in the frame.
style: flat vector isometric illustration, polished marketing-illustration quality
render: crisp clean edges, two-tone flat shading with soft contact shadows, generous negative space, dark charcoal ground #16161A fading slightly darker at the edges; grey objects #8E8E96 to #B4B4BC; the subject of the image in brand blue #5B8AEF; the result or win in gold #D79F1E; nothing else coloured; browser window dots are always plain grey, never coloured
camera: isometric 30 degrees, subject centred slightly left, upper third of the frame kept empty
light: one soft key from upper left, soft shadows, no glow, no bloom
composition: ultra minimal: two objects and one arrow, nothing else, at least two thirds of the frame empty, centred, straight-on flat view
